newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Rep. Leach seeks information on Lippo Bank.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Rep. Leach seeks information on Lippo Bank.

text.p: House Banking Committee Chairman James Leach asked regulators this week for records on banks related to the Lippo Group of Indonesia, a committee aide said on Friday.

Leach, R-Iowa, asked the Federal Reserve, Federal Deposit Insurance Corp and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency for materials on Lippo Bank in Los Angeles and the former Worthen National Bank of Arkansas, the aide said.
The request came after press reports raised questions about ties between the wealthy Indonesian Riady family, which owns Lippo Group, and President Clinton.
Spokesmen at the three regulators said the requested information was being gathered. Worthen no longer exists as a firm after it was acquired by another bank.
FDIC Chairman Ricki Helfer recused herself from issues connected with Lippo Bank, the FDIC said in a statement.

Helfer has not had any dealings with the bank, but questions were raised regarding the bank during Senate Whitewater hearings, the FDIC said. Helfer in connection with her confirmation executed a recusal with respect to all Whitewater matters, the FDIC said.
